theorem one : Weighted (1:(ℚ[X])[X])
theorem C {P : ℚ[X]} (hP : Content 0 P) : Weighted (C P)
theorem add {P Q : (ℚ[X])[X]} (hP : Weighted P) (hQ : Weighted Q) : Weighted (P+Q)
theorem sub {P Q : (ℚ[X])[X]} (hP : Weighted P) (hQ : Weighted Q) : Weighted (P-Q)
theorem mul {P Q : (ℚ[X])[X]} (hP : Weighted P) (hQ : Weighted Q) : Weighted (P*Q)
theorem pow {P : (ℚ[X])[X]} (hP : Weighted P) (n : ℕ) : Weighted (P^n)
theorem prod {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (P : ι → (ℚ[X])[X]) (hP : ∀ j ∈ S,Weighted (P j)) : Weighted (∏ j ∈ S,P j)
theorem sum {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (P : ι → (ℚ[X])[X]) (hP : ∀ j ∈ S,Weighted (P j)) : Weighted (∑ j ∈ S,P j)
theorem weighted_affine (A B : ℚ[X]) (hA : Content 0 A) (hB : Content 1 B) : Weighted (C A+C B*X)
theorem weighted_geometric (D : (ℚ[X])[X]) (k : ℕ) (hD : Weighted D) : Weighted (geometricRows D k)
theorem eval_tail_content (P : (ℚ[X])[X]) (hP : Weighted P) (k : ℕ) (hz : ∀ n<k,P.coeff n=0) (z : ℤ) : Content (k:ℤ) (P.eval (C (z:ℚ)))
theorem weighted_low (P : (ℚ[X])[X]) (k : ℕ) (hP : Weighted P) : Weighted (lowRows P k)
theorem low_rows_error (P : (ℚ[X])[X]) (hP : Weighted P) (k : ℕ) (z : ℤ) : Content (k:ℤ) (P.eval (C (z:ℚ))-(lowRows P k).eval (C (z:ℚ)))
theorem anchor_rows_weighted (u x y : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : Weighted (anchorRows u x y m)
theorem denom_rows_weighted (a u i x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hiu : i<u) (hu : u≤a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hc : x.testBit i=y.testBit i) : Weighted (denomRows a u x y t m)

theorem approx_rows_weighted (a u i x y k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hy : y<2^a) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (hu : u≤a) (hc : x.testBit i=y.testBit i) : Weighted (approxRows a u i x y k t m)
theorem anchor_ratio_inverse (u x y : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : (correctionRatio u x (rowResidue u x) y m)⁻¹ = ∏ j ∈ mask u x y, (1+slope u (rowResidue u x) y ((2:ℚ)^j)*(rowQuotient u x:ℚ))^m j
theorem anchor_rows_eval (u x y : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : (anchorRows u x y m).eval (C (rowQuotient u x:ℚ)) = C ((correctionRatio u x (rowResidue u x) y m)⁻¹)

theorem row_denominator_split (u x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (hd : (t:ℚ)-delta (rowResidue u x) y ≠ 0) : ((t:ℚ)-delta x y)/((t:ℚ)-delta (rowResidue u x) y)= 1+slope u (rowResidue u x) y (t:ℚ)*(rowQuotient u x:ℚ)

theorem denom_rows_eval (a u i x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hiu : i<u) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hc : x.testBit i=y.testBit i) : (denomRows a u x y t m).eval (C (rowQuotient u x:ℚ))=rowDenominator a u x y t m
theorem geometric_rows_eval (D : (ℚ[X])[X]) (k : ℕ) (h : ℚ[X]) : (geometricRows D k).eval h=geometricInverse (D.eval h) k

theorem actual_approx_rows_eval (a u i x y k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hiu : i<u) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hc : x.testBit i=y.testBit i) : (approxRows a u i x y k t m).eval (C (rowQuotient u x:ℚ))= actualChartApproximation a u i x y k t m

theorem actual_low_rows_precision (a u i x y k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hx : x<2^a) (hy : y<2^a) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (hu : u≤a) (hc : x.testBit i=y.testBit i) : Content (k:ℤ) (normalizedNodeEntry a u i x y t m- (lowRows (approxRows a u i x y k t m) k).eval (C (rowQuotient u x:ℚ)))
theorem anchor_rows_class (u x y : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : anchorRows u x y m=anchorRows u (rowResidue u x) y m
theorem denom_rows_class (a u x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : denomRows a u x y t m=denomRows a u (rowResidue u x) y t m
theorem numerator_rows_class (a u i x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : rowNumerator a u i x y t m=rowNumerator a u i (rowResidue u x) y t m
theorem approx_rows_class (a u i x y k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : approxRows a u i x y k t m=approxRows a u i (rowResidue u x) y k t m
theorem low_rows_eval (P : (ℚ[X])[X]) (k : ℕ) (h : ℚ[X]) : (lowRows P k).eval h=∑ b : Fin k,P.coeff b.val*h^b.val
theorem poly_left_weight (a u k : ℕ) (x : Ports a) (rb : MomentLabels u k) : Content (rb.2.val:ℤ) (polyLeft a u k x rb)

theorem poly_right_integral (a u i k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (hu : u≤a) (rb : MomentLabels u k) (y : Ports a) : Content 0 (polyRight a u i k t m rb y)
theorem coefficient_moment_cancel (b : ℕ) (h : ℚ) (R : ℚ[X]) : C ((2:ℚ)^b*h^b)*(C (((2:ℚ)^b)⁻¹)*R)=R*(C h)^b

theorem poly_product (a u i k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (x y : Ports a) : (polyLeft a u k*polyRight a u i k t m) x y = if (rowResidue u x.val).testBit i=y.val.testBit i then (lowRows (approxRows a u i (rowResidue u x.val) y.val k t m) k).eval (C (rowQuotient u x.val:ℚ)) else 0

theorem actual_compact_poly_precision (a u i k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (hu : u≤a) (x y : Ports a) : Content (k:ℤ) (nodePolynomialMatrix a u i t m x y- (polyLeft a u k*polyRight a u i k t m) x y)
theorem weighted_left_weight (a u i k : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hiu : i<u) (hu : u≤a) (x : Ports a) (rb : MomentLabels u k) : Content (jetWeight a u i m+rb.2.val) (weightedLeft a u i k m x rb)
theorem weighted_left_integral (a u i k : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hiu : i<u) (hu : u≤a) (hw : 0≤jetWeight a u i m) (x : Ports a) (rb : MomentLabels u k) : Content 0 (weightedLeft a u i k m x rb)

theorem weighted_poly_product (a u i k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (x y : Ports a) : (weightedLeft a u i k m*polyRight a u i k t m) x y= C (diagonalJet a u i m)*(polyLeft a u k*polyRight a u i k t m) x y

theorem actual_compact_weighted_precision (a u i k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (hu : u≤a) (x y : Ports a) : Content (jetWeight a u i m+k) (nodeCrossingPolynomial a u i t m x y- (weightedLeft a u i k m*polyRight a u i k t m) x y)

theorem actual_compact_weighted_profile (a u i k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (hu : u≤a) : (∀ (x : Ports a) (rb : MomentLabels u k), Content (jetWeight a u i m+rb.2.val) (weightedLeft a u i k m x rb)) ∧ (∀ (rb : MomentLabels u k) (y : Ports a),Content 0 (polyRight a u i k t m rb y)) ∧ (∀ x y : Ports a,Content (jetWeight a u i m+k) (nodeCrossingPolynomial a u i t m x y- (weightedLeft a u i k m*polyRight a u i k t m) x y)) ∧ Fintype.card (MomentLabels u k)=2^u*k
